key_insight: ScaleToT scales structured LLM-style reasoning from a small subset of users to billions of sparse-profile users by distilling reliable typed reasoning chains into lightweight models.
engineering_relevance: This enables cost-effective large-scale user modeling for advertising systems that need strong predictions without running expensive LLM inference on every user.
method: Build typed user-state chains with entropy-guided Tree-of-Thought refinement to improve reasoning quality.
Use teacher-curated chains to train a student on static profiles with supervised fine-tuning and OSIPO.
Transfer the student’s reasoning representations into a lightweight profile encoder to generalize to the full low-activity population.
evidence_signal: In a billion-scale advertising deployment, a randomized online A/B test improved LT30 by 6.738%, while offline reasoning covered only 7.32% of the potential population.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of the small LLM-processed training subset and the reliability of sparse-profile signals, so distribution shift could limit transfer.
paper_title: ScaleToT: Generalizing Structured LLM Reasoning for Billion-Scale Low-Activity User Modeling
